title: [observability] 230's notes: the last day's gain says "Free disk gained over the last day" ("day" once); a figure whose name lacks the turned words is not turned; 233.sh plants another figure below zero (abs-always, any-key-turn die black box)
prompt:
Spawn, objective 233 [observability] (the lead's contract of 2026-11-19, "the next change from 230's notes, one contract"; author rev-e; readers rev-k, then rev-b; from rev-j's 230 R1 notes n1-n3 and rev-k's abs-always note): the last day's gain says "day" once; only the names 230 turns are turned; another figure below zero keeps its minus, black box.

Base: live main 2dbddac9 (230's src 450e3a55 and owner 230.sh).

The problems, on 230 as landed:
- n3: a disk that gained over the last day reads "Free disk gained a day (over the last day)": "day" twice.
- n2: mark() turns storage.disk_fall or storage.grew_most below zero even when its name lacks the words it turns (" lost ", " grew most"): the size loses its minus and the name keeps saying what the serve says, so a renamed serve figure would read "lost" beside a positive size.
- n1 / rev-k: 230.sh has no other figure below zero, so a change that drops every figure's minus (abs-always) or turns any figure below zero (any-key-turn) passes it; only the unit test catches them.

Read first: web/src/coreLines.ts (mark, TURNED, basisWords); web/test/coreLines.test.ts (objective 230's test); rsi/scenarios/230.sh; rsi/scenarios/185.sh (how host.storage_bytes readings and a landing are planted).

What changes (web/src and web/test; owner: the scenarios):
(1) storage.disk_fall below zero with basis "day": the name's " lost a day" becomes " gained over the last day", and no basis words follow ("Free disk gained over the last day", the value |value| in its words, "… a day"). With basis "fit" or none it stays as 230 says it ("Free disk gained a day (the week's fit)").
(2) A turned figure whose name does not hold the words it would turn is not turned: its name, basis words and signed value are as for any other figure.
(3) Everything else is as on 230: grew_most below zero, both figures at zero and above, every other figure, range and tone.

Files: web/src/coreLines.ts, web/test/coreLines.test.ts; owner: rsi/scenarios/233.sh (new), rsi/scenarios/230.sh ((2)'s expected name only: "Free disk gained over the last day"), rsi/backlog/233.json.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/233.sh, black box on its own database, through GET /api/core-lines of a real spawn serve, each answer read through web/src/coreLines.ts's coreLinesView under node as the page does. 230.sh's three worlds of hourly host.core_lines samples, plus, in every world, two host.storage_bytes readings 47 h apart (transcripts 8 MiB, then 2 MiB) with one task.landed between them, as 185.sh plants them, so the storage north star "Bytes a landing leaves behind" is below zero:
- (1) the fit's gain: "Free disk gained a day (the week's fit)", the size positive; "Store that shrank least: <store>", the size positive;
- (2) the day's gain: "Free disk gained over the last day", the word "day" once in the name, the size positive; the store that shrank least, positive;
- (3) both falling: "Free disk lost a day" with its basis words and "Store that grew most", as before 230;
- (4) in each world, no other figure says "gained" or "shrank least";
- (5) in each world, every other figure below zero (the north star at least) is said as the serve names it, with its minus: its name starts with the serve's name, and its value starts with unitWords(unit, signed value) and has a minus.
Each world's signs, basis and the north star below zero are checked first (a harness fault otherwise). On live main 2dbddac9, 233.sh exits 1 at (2).

Tests (unit, web/test/coreLines.test.ts): 230's test with the day's name now "Free disk gained over the last day"; a new test: the day's gain says "day" once, |value|; each turned key under a name without its words ("Free disk fell" under fit and day, "Free disk lost per day" under day, "Largest store growth") keeps its name, the fall's basis words and its signed value. No test is renamed or dropped.

Not black box: (2) needs a serve name other than the serve's own, which the serve cannot send; the unit test holds it (mutant noop-guard-dropped dies there only).

Verified by: after landing, on live, while storage.disk_fall is below zero with basis "day", the Fleet page's diagnostics say "Free disk gained over the last day" (or, with basis "fit", "Free disk gained a day (the week's fit)"), and "Bytes a landing leaves behind" keeps its sign (the lead's look, with /api/core-lines at the same minute).
